display.heading: Add a human
display.consequence: Create this human ID in the organisation.

display.heading: Confirm this enrollment
display.consequence: Bind these approval keys to this pending human ID.

display.heading: Replace approval keys
display.consequence: Change this person’s identity key and approval-key binding.

canonical_team_id.description: Canonical lowercase name:domain; SDK ParseTeamID/BuildTeamID owns normalization.

display.heading: Approve a root agent
display.consequence: Approve this person’s root. Adoption keeps the root’s ID, key and agents. At a team-key enforcer, replace its admission grant with exactly the listed teams; an empty list withdraws the grant. A team added later needs a new approval of the full list. Agent descendants are attributed through the ID chain.

agent.root.authorize.description: Team IDs are canonical lowercase name:domain, sorted and unique. Each act replaces the full team list; a later mapped team is outside the grant until a new act lists the full set. expected_revision is the revision of this enforcer’s grant record for (organisation, person, root_id): 0 when absent, then incremented once per committed grant replacement, including empty-list withdrawal. An idempotent retry does not increment it. The enforcer reads its own record and returns the current revision inside the canonical R carried by its 428 needs_human prepare answer. The caller carries that R unchanged; no registry or separate public revision lookup is needed. An aw enforcer has no team grant record, accepts only empty teams and uses revision 0.

human_enrolled_later.meaning: Only the current namespace controller obtained from checked namespace public authority may sign this statement; the artifact never supplies its own trust anchor. The issuer states that this person can approve with the credential and grade exercised in this enrollment ceremony. since is the issuer clock when signing this statement, not a registry-witnessed time or a WebAuthn signing time. enrollment.confirmation_receipt_commitment binds this ceremony receipt C; if transition is present it equals transition.confirmation_receipt_commitment. Earlier enrollment facts are referenced by the existing transition history. Existing replacement/recovery authority and modes remain unchanged. This states no creation fact.
human_enrolled_later.display: can approve since T (issuer's statement), grade G (issuer's statement)
